title: CM5 USB Boot
subtitle: Exposes a Compute Module's eMMC / NVMe to this computer over USB, ready for Raspberry Pi Imager.
device.help: Fit the nRPIBOOT jumper, connect USB-C to this computer and power the board.
option.pcie_help: Try this if NVMe does not show up: dtparam=pciex1 is added to a temporary copy of the gadget.
hint.mmc_only: Only eMMC / SD showed up. If you expect NVMe, power-cycle the board and retry with "Force PCIe".
log.title: Log
result.ok: rpiboot finished. The disk should appear within a few seconds.
error.rpiboot-missing: rpiboot or mass-storage-gadget64 was not found.
error.imager-missing: Raspberry Pi Imager was not found.
